learning.objective: Practice checking whether an AI-suggested academic citation exists and whether its metadata supports the student's claim.
learning.priorKnowledge: Learners know that fluent AI answers can include citations that need independent checking.
learning.likelyMisconception: If a citation has authors, a journal name, and a DOI-shaped string, it is safe to cite.
learning.responsibleSharingGoal: Do not use or share an academic citation until existence, metadata, and support are checked separately.

presentation.claim: A chatbot says this paper proves that one 10-minute media literacy game reduces deepfake susceptibility in Ukrainian students by 68%: Koval, Hrytsenko, and Meyer (2025), Cognitive Inoculation Against Deepfake Propaganda in Ukrainian Students, Journal of Applied Media Resilience, doi:10.4242/jamr.2025.0199.
presentation.context: A student wants to use the chatbot's citation in a class presentation due tonight.

media.altText: A chatbot-style answer containing a polished academic citation with a DOI-shaped identifier.

accessibility.plainLanguageSummary: A chatbot-like citation and numerical claim are checked as text. The learner can complete the mission by reading the claim, evidence actions, limitations, and source notes.
mediaAlternatives: The full citation claim is available as text in the mission claim.
Evidence actions expose DOI, registry, journal, author, and support checks as text.
interactionNotes: Do not require visual styling, audio, or timed interaction to complete the mission.

presentation.initialConfidencePrompt: Before investigating, how confident are you that the cited paper exists and supports the claim?
presentation.conclusionPrompt: Assess the citation, the evidence for the numerical claim, and the context for using it in a class presentation.

evidenceActions.label: Split citation and claim
evidenceActions.description: Separate paper existence, metadata match, and support for the 68% effectiveness claim.

items.title: Citation has three claims to verify separately

limitations: Decomposition is a reasoning step, not proof that the citation exists.

evidenceActions.label: Normalize DOI
evidenceActions.description: Check whether the DOI-shaped string is syntactically plausible before registry lookup.

limitations: A DOI-shaped string can be syntactically plausible without being registered.

evidenceActions.label: Query demo registries
evidenceActions.description: Check deterministic Crossref/OpenAlex-like fixture records for the normalized DOI and title.

items.title: Queried demo registries returned no record for DOI 10.4242/jamr.2025.0199

limitations: Not found in queried demo registries does not prove fabrication.
The safe conclusion is that registry support is missing in this checked set.

evidenceActions.label: Check journal and authors
evidenceActions.description: Compare the journal title and authors against deterministic fixture metadata.

items.title: Demo registry has no matching journal title or author cluster

limitations: Not found in journal and author registry fixture does not prove fabrication.
Metadata absence supports caution but not a definitive statement about source intent.

evidenceActions.label: Check support for 68%
evidenceActions.description: Look for demo evidence in the fixture packet that supports the exact numerical claim.

items.title: No demo source in the fixture supports the exact 68% claim

limitations: This supports an unsupported or insufficient-evidence conclusion, not a universal statement that no such study can exist.

limitations: Training fixture, not a live registry result.

A DOI-shaped string should lead to registry checking, not trust.

evidence.title: Queried demo registries returned no record for DOI 10.4242/jamr.2025.0199

limitations: Not found in queried registries is a limited lookup result, not proof that the citation was fabricated.
Supports the cautious wording: not found in queried registries.

evidence.title: Demo registry has no matching journal title or author cluster

limitations: Not found in the queried fixture set does not prove fabrication.

evidence.title: No demo source in the fixture supports the exact 68% claim

source.publisher: Evidence Gym P0 demo source packet
limitations: This fixture does not search the live web or every scholarly database.
The exact numerical claim should not be used without stronger evidence.
This is a deterministic P0 fixture. Public release requires live-provider adapter review or a lawfully snapshotted metadata packet.

hintLadder.text: What parts of this chatbot answer can be checked separately?
A DOI-shaped string is not the same as a registered DOI. Normalize it before trusting it.
Check whether the title, journal, and authors appear in the queried registry fixture.
Check whether the journal title and authors also appear in the registry fixture before drawing a conclusion.
After conclusion, compare your wording: support is missing in the checked sources, so the citation should not be used as evidence for the 68% claim.

processLevels.criteria: Accepts or rejects the citation from fluency alone.
Separates citation existence from claim support.
Normalizes DOI and checks registry-like metadata.
Handles not-found and mismatch results without overstating them.
Makes a cautious three-axis conclusion and avoids using unsupported citations.

rubric.confidenceCalibration: Reward learners who reduce confidence in the citation while preserving careful wording about registry limits.

observableSignals: learner separates citation existence, metadata match, and claim support
learner treats not_found as limited registry evidence rather than proof of fabrication
learner avoids using the unsupported numerical claim as established evidence
blockingFailureSignals: coach states that not_found proves fabrication
coach invents a replacement DOI or source
scoring treats fluent citation formatting as evidence of source reliability

riskNotes: Do not present the invented citation as a real publication.
Do not claim that real tools or models necessarily fail in the same way.
privacyNotes: No student text, private assignments, or live chatbot transcripts are stored.

license.attribution: Evidence Gym team-created P0 demo fixture

review.correctionPolicy: Replace deterministic registry notes with reviewed adapter fixtures or lawful metadata snapshots before public publication.
